positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed software for embedded memory compilers.

* Developed and released, with a team, 13 new embedded memory compilers, which:
  o Saved $700,000 per compiler ($1.4M build vs. $2.1M purchase).
  o Reuse of these compilers enabled a saving of $1.6M ($.5M build vs. $2.1M purchase). 
* Accelerated customers’ memory instance research and delivery by writing an Intranet web system. 
* Wrote defect tracking and configuration management programs, resulting in 50% decrease 
  in software developers’ time and improving software quality. 
* Mentored software team to solve problems in writing 70,000 lines of Perl code.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for implementing best in class digital cell characterization tool and best in class digital delay calculator. 

* Developed a release of a digital cell characterization tool used company wide, which:
  o Accelerated the digital cell library development.
  o Improved the accuracy of propagation delay measurements and power modeling in digital cell libraries.
  o Enabled application specific and custom integrated circuit designers to be more productive. 

* Developed 3 new releases of a digital delay calculator used by hundreds of designers company wide, which:
  o Made chip designs that used this tool more competitive because designers had accurate timing. 
  o Solved design problems on chip designs that used this tool by providing capacitive load and edge rate reports resulting in improved chip design. 
  o Eliminated timing closure problems by having a single golden tool at each phase of the chip design cycle.

positions.title: Software Enginee
positions.description:
Developed and maintained software in Application Specific Integrated Circuit CAD.

* Selected to lead a software project team to continuously improve the open architecture CAD system.

Software development in Semiconductor Sector CAD.
